title: BELLS / BLOOM — PointCast Showcast 001
dek: A bell is a flower you can hear.
body:
BELLS / BLOOM gathers twenty-eight works from Michael Hoydich's Midjourney archive into four movements: Signal Garden, Soft Structure, Blue Hour, and Afterimage.

The showcast begins with a recurring visual contradiction: a Bell Labs signal crossed with ikebana balance, Warhol color, Hockney light, midcentury systems, and beautiful machine weather. An alarm gains the composure of a vase. A flower becomes something you can hear.

The full-screen drift viewer advances every eight seconds, supports swipe and keyboard navigation, and can add optional generative bell tones. Every image keeps a direct link to its exact Midjourney job. The complete 28-work manifest is also published as JSON.
